changes: Upgraded reasoning & architecture plane to Gemini 4 Argon (High Reasoning) with full Apache-2.0 Google LLC governance
Expanded crates/carbon_ffi to 9 zero-copy Rust 2024 C ABI kernels: 8-way SIMD Dot, Cosine Similarity, Softmax, Gemma Unit-Offset RMSNorm, GeGLU, RoPE, MatVec, and Fused Gemma Layer Step
Added complete Model Context Protocol (MCP) JSON-RPC 2.0 server (@carbon/mcp-server) over HTTP /mcp and stdio
Built 5 WGSL compute shaders in @carbon/webgpu-gemma (Tiled MatMul, Gemma RMSNorm, RoPE, GeGLU, Softmax)
Configured Google-First Paris (europe-west9) Cloud Run, Cloud Build, and Vertex AI TPU v6e deployment manifests
Initial dual-stack Bun v1.4.4+ and Astral uv v0.13.7 workspace layout

bestPractices.description: Pass Float32Array pointers directly via ptr(typedArray) to Rust #[unsafe(no_mangle)] extern 'C' kernels compiled with lto='fat', codegen-units=1, and panic='unwind'. Eliminates JSON/Protobuf serialization overhead.

Gemma architectures scale normalized activations by (1.0 + weight[i]) rather than weight[i], and use tanh-approximated GELU in the gated MLP. Both are enforced identically in Rust FFI and WebGPU WGSL shaders.

bestPractices.rule: Zero Long-Lived Service Account Keys (ADC + WIF)
bestPractices.description: Authenticate to Vertex AI (europe-west9 / us-central1) exclusively using short-lived OAuth 2.0 access tokens via 'gcloud auth application-default print-access-token' or Workload Identity Federation.

bestPractices.rule: Pure Annotations & sideEffects: false Across Workspaces
bestPractices.description: Declare '"sideEffects": false' in every workspace package.json and avoid dynamic eval() so 'bun compile --outfile bin/carbon.exe' performs maximum dead-code elimination.

gcloudCliSetup.step: 1. Configure Google Cloud Primary Region (Paris europe-west9) & Project
gcloudCliSetup.cmd:
gcloud config set project carbon-intelligence-2026
gcloud config set run/region europe-west9
gcloud config set ai/region europe-west9

gcloudCliSetup.step: 2. Enable Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry & Compute APIs
gcloudCliSetup.cmd: gcloud services enable aiplatform.googleapis.com run.googleapis.com artifactregistry.googleapis.com cloudbuild.googleapis.com compute.googleapis.com

gcloudCliSetup.step: 3. Deploy Carbon Control Plane to Google Cloud Run (Paris europe-west9)
4. Submit Gemma 4 E2B Upstream Bun QLoRA Fine-Tuning Job to Vertex AI
5. Stream Gemini 4 / Gemma 4 Inference via Tokenless ADC
gcloudCliSetup.cmd:
curl -X POST https://europe-west9-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/carbon-intelligence-2026/locations/europe-west9/publishers/google/models/gemini-4-argon:streamGenerateContent \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"contents":[{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"Explain Upstream Bun src/aot SSA passes"}]}]}'
